description:
Draw on a SketchXFlow canvas page with your own judgement: create frames, shapes, text, vectors and pictures, restyle, group, re-parent, reorder, duplicate or delete them — up to 300 ops in one call, saved as ONE step (Undo in the editor reverts it). Nothing is generated on SketchXFlow's side and no coins are spent. The result is real, responsive-ready HTML that opens in the editor like a hand-drawn design. Returns the new names and the page's shape outline; check the look with sketchxflow_get_image.

Ops (applied in order, all or nothing; shapes are addressed by their unique name `id`; coordinates are px relative to the parent; the canvas is 1440 wide and grows to fit):
• create — {op:"create", type, parent?, name?, x, y, w, h, ...props}. type: frame | rect | ellipse | text | line | arrow | polygon | star | path | image. parent: a frame or group name (default the canvas). text: {text:"Line one\nLine two", w? (fixed width; omit for auto width)}. line/arrow: {x1,y1,x2,y2}. polygon/star: {points?, inner_ratio?}. path: {d, view_box?:"0 0 24 24"} (SVG path, e.g. an icon). image: {src:"https://…", alt, fit?:"cover|contain|fill"}.
• update — {op:"update", id, ...props, name? (rename), x1..y2 for a line, d for a path}.
• delete — {op:"delete", id} or {ids:[...]}.   • duplicate — {op:"duplicate", id, dx?, dy?, name?}.
• group — {op:"group", ids:[...same parent], name?}.   • ungroup — {op:"ungroup", id}.
• move — {op:"move", id, parent? (re-parent, keeps its place on the page), index?, to?: "front"|"back"|"forward"|"backward"}.
• canvas — {op:"canvas", height?, background?, transition?: "fade"|"slide"|"zoom"|"rise"|"none"} — transition: how this page arrives when a link opens it.
• responsive — {op:"responsive", id?}: make the page (or one frame) work on every screen — auto layout worked out from where things sit, rows wrap, big text and spacing scale down, overlapping visuals scale as one picture, the menu hides on phones. Do it LAST, after drawing at 1440 wide (and again after big changes); check with sketchxflow_get_image.
• semantics — {op:"semantics"}: tags from how the page looks — one h1, h2/h3 for titles, header, nav, section, footer, blockquote (tags you set yourself are kept).   • meta — {op:"meta", title, description, lang}: the page title, search description and language.
• styles — {op:"styles", colors?:{Brand:"#7C3AED"}, text?:{Heading:{size,weight,line_height,letter_spacing,family,color}}, effects?:{Lift:"0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.15)"}, remove?:[names]}: shared styles, defined once. Use them by name: fill / color / stroke "style:Brand", text_style:"Heading", effect_style:"Lift" — change the style later and every shape using it follows. A Google font family is loaded on the page automatically.
• icon — {op:"icon", name:"arrow-right", label? (the layer name), x, y, size?:24, color?, stroke_width?:2, parent?, aria_label?}: a Lucide icon as a vector (find names with sketchxflow_canvas_find kind "icons").
• taste — {op:"taste", section:"<id or name>", x?:0, y, w?:1440, parent?}: a ready-made Taste section (hero, pricing, footer…) placed as a frame; its CSS comes with it (sketchxflow_canvas_find kind "sections").
• create type "section" (a page section frame, tagged <section>) and type "video" ({src: an https .mp4 / .webm / .mov, poster?: a picture, autoplay?: true (muted, loops, plays while on screen) | false with controls?: true (plays on a click, with sound), loop?}) and type "model" ({src: an https .glb / .gltf — sketchxflow_canvas_find kind "models", alt, auto_rotate, camera_controls, camera_orbit:"30deg 70deg 100%", orbit for scroll}).
• Components: component {id} makes a main; instance {id, x, y, parent?, name?} places a copy; prop {id: a layer inside the main, kind:"text"|"visible"|"off"} makes it a property (copies keep their own text / show-hide); push {id} updates every copy from the main; variant {id, name:"Hover"} adds a variant beside it; swap {id: a copy, variant:"Hover"}.
• boolean — {op:"boolean", ids:[2+ shapes, same parent], kind:"union"|"subtract"|"intersect"|"exclude", name?}: one vector from their outlines (the first one keeps its fill).
• Layout: align {ids, to:"left|center|right|top|middle|bottom", relative?:"selection"|"parent"} · distribute {ids (3+), axis:"x"|"y", gap?} · fill_width {id, margin?} · equal {ids, dim:"height"|"width"} · center {id, axis?:"x"|"y"|"both"}. Pass measure:true on the call so text sizes are measured in a real browser first.
Props: fill (colour or CSS gradient; for text it is the text colour), stroke ({color,width} or a colour + stroke_width; "none" removes), radius (number or [tl,tr,br,bl]), opacity (0–1), rotation (deg), flip_x / flip_y, shadow (CSS box-shadow), blur (px), clip (frames), scroll (frames: "x" a carousel that scrolls sideways — stays one row on phones —, "y" a list that scrolls down, null), min_w / max_w (px), font_size, font_weight, font_family, color, align (left|center|right|justify), line_height, letter_spacing, italic, underline, uppercase, width_mode (auto|fixed), link (https://…, mailto:, tel:, #id or a page slug), hidden, locked, grid ({columns,gutter,margin} layout grid on a frame, or false), layout (frames: {direction:"row"|"column", gap, padding, align, justify, wrap} = auto layout, children flow; "none" removes), style ({css-property: value} for anything else the design panel sets), tag (what it is: text → h1–h6, p, blockquote, li, span, label; frames → section, header, nav, footer, article, aside, figure, ul, button), aria_label, responsive ("flow" | "scale" | "fixed" to override how a frame behaves on small screens), crop (pictures: {zoom 1–8, x, y focus 0–100} or null).
Motion props: anim ({trigger:"load|enter|scroll|hover|click|loop", dur ms, delay, ease:"ease-out|spring|smooth|snappy|bounce|cubic-bezier(…)", iter, alt, stagger ms (children one after another), range:[0,1] (scroll), path:"<a vector's name>" (move along it), keys:[{o:0, op:0, y:40, x, s, r, rx, ry, bg, c, blur}, {o:1, op:1, y:0}] — the last key is how it rests}), hover / press ({s:1.05, y:-4, shadow, bg, c, dur} — smart-animated), on ({click:"overlay:Name|toggle:Name|scroll:Name|close|page:slug", hover:"show:Name"}), overlay (true: hidden until opened), parallax (-2–2), pin (stays while its section scrolls), tilt (deg, follows the pointer). Reduced motion is respected and animations pause off screen on their own.
Effects props: blend (multiply, screen, overlay…), glow ({color, size}), inner_shadow ({color, size, x, y}), outline ({color, width, offset}), adjust ({brightness, contrast, saturate, hue, grayscale, sepia} in %), gradient_map ([2–5 hex, dark→light]; 2 = duotone), soft_mask ({direction:"to bottom|…|radial", feather}), text_image (a picture inside the text's letters), grain (0.1–1), perspective / rotate_x / rotate_y (CSS 3D).

measure.description: Measure the page in a browser first, so align / distribute / equal / center use real text sizes.

ops.description: The ops, in order — see the tool description.

name: sketchxflow_canvas_apply
title: Draw / change shapes on a canvas page
